page_title: MNT 0-5 MAR | Montpellier v Marseille 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' The match has just finished.
90+1' Total attempts – 11:21.
90' 1 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee has issued a yellow card to Enzo Sternal (Marseille).
86' Substitution. Falaye Sacko walks off the pitch and Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) comes on as a substitute.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tanguy Coulibaly trots off the pitch and is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
83' Nice passing game by Marseille. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
79' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Valentin Rongier (Marseille) replacing Ulisses Garcia.
79' Substitution. Enzo Sternal (Marseille) replaces Amine Harit.
77' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Mason Greenwood (Marseille) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
73' 0 - 5 Goal! Luis Henrique (Marseille) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:5.
73' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
70' Substitution. Elye Wahi is replaced by Ismael Kone (Marseille).
69' Neat passing move from Montpellier in order to create new attacking opportunities.
64' Stefan Dzodic (Montpellier) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
63' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier).
60' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Jonathan Rowe is replaced by Luis Henrique (Marseille).
60' Substitution. Michael Murillo (Marseille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pol Lirola walks off.
58' 0 - 4 Goal! Elye Wahi plays a short, square pass into the path of Mason Greenwood (Marseille), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 0:4. Fabulous goal!
58' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner but it's cleared.
56' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a change. Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) replaces Issiaga Sylla.
55' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is being substituted because of an injury. Michel Der Zakarian sends Stefan Dzodic on the pitch.

55' Elye Wahi (Marseille) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
53' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
52' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.

51' Akor Adams (Montpellier) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up low in the middle of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
51' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick.
40' 0 - 3 Goal! Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
39' Michel Der Zakarian is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Joris Chotard (Montpellier) suffers an injury and Jordan Ferri comes on.
36' 0 - 2 Goal! Amine Harit (Marseille) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net.
33' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
32' The ball is out of play. Marseille will take a throw-in.
29' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Montpellier win a free kick.
27' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
27' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Montpellier was in an offside position.
26' It's a throw-in for Montpellier.

25' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Montpellier, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
24' The Montpellier players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

22' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Montpellier.
19' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Derek Cornelius (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
19' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Marseille take a short corner kick.
17' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
16' Clement Turpin interrupts the game. One of the players from Montpellier won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. That's a free kick to Marseille.
15' Amine Harit (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
14' Amine Harit (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Montpellier enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
11' Great teamplay by Marseille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
10' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
8' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Montpellier is cautioned for aggressive play. It's a free kick to Marseille, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
8' Clement Turpin interrupts the game. One of the players from Marseille won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Montpellier will take a free kick.

7' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal! The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
6' A player from Marseille commits a rough challenge. Clement Turpin blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick is awarded to Montpellier.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Montpellier.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonathan Rowe gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Elye Wahi (Marseille), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 0:1.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Marseille will take the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
